default/30619.htm.text: Vuku Chief Driko: I am Driko, the Chief of the Vuku Orcs. Our tribe moved here after we were deprived of our base camp in the Cruma Marshlands by the insects. If you are also one of those who threaten our tribe, we will not let you leave in peace!

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30619-01.html.text: Vuku Chief Driko: Oh oppressor of flames, why has such a noble person come to this obscure place? Have you come to meet me, Driko, leader of the Vuku tribe? Right now, I am facing a problem which could be a matter of life and death for my tribe! I have no interest in the glory of the old kingdom. Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30619-02.html.text: Vuku Chief Driko: For us, survival is the greatest virtue. I knew that there would come a day when this seal would be traded for the safety of our tribe. We have many difficulties in this area, often coming into conflicts with Humans. We plan to return to our base camp. We are moving to the eastern…

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30619-04.html.text: Vuku Chief Driko: I am facing a big problem which could be a matter of life and death for my tribe! I have no interest in the glory of the old kingdom. Per the agreement between us, I shall give you our tribal scepter when you kill the drones among the swamp stakatos and bring me 30 of their husks .

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30619-06.html.text: Vuku Chief Driko: The agreement is settled, and we have already given you the Scepter of Flame ! There is no more Contract between us! As I told you before, I have no interest in the reunification of the ancient kingdom!

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30619-07.html.text: Vuku Chief Driko: I am not at all interested in the reunification of our ancient kingdom nor in the symbol of its authority. You noble Orcs will die in the end after fighting for supremacy over the continent, be we shall survive for eternity!

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30619-03.html.text: Vuku Chief Driko: It appears that the swamp stakatos are unable to breed without the drones. Therefore you must go and exterminate the drones first. Kill them all and gather 30 husks . Bring them back to me and I shall give you the Scepter of Flame.
